title: NASA Hit a Comet at 23,000 mph, and It Was 75% Empty Space

scenes.text: NASA fired an 820-pound projectile at a comet.
It hit at about twenty-three thousand miles an hour.
The blast threw out millions of kilograms of dust and water.
A camera on a nearby spacecraft watched it all.
The surprise: the comet was about seventy-five percent empty space.
A comet mostly full of nothing, hit at twenty-three thousand miles an hour.

description:
NASA fired an 820-pound projectile at a comet.
On July 4, 2005, the Deep Impact mission hit comet Tempel 1 at about 23,000 mph and found it was around 75 percent empty space.
What comet would you hit next?
thumbnail_text: NASA HIT A COMET AT 23,000 MPH
first_comment: Bonus: the dust was finer than expected, closer to talcum powder than sand. Would you want to touch a comet?
